acceptance.given: A Skill package is classified as a leaf while its declaration includes routing or orchestration behavior.

oracle.expected: The validator reports a failing assessment with a diagnostic identifying the false-leaf classification.
forbidden: A Skill declaring routing passes through a false leaf classification.
oracle.observable: The structured validator result contains a failing status and the false-leaf rule or diagnostic identifier.

acceptance.then: The assessment fails with a diagnostic tied to the false-leaf classification rule.
acceptance.when: During runtime validation, invoke the real validator against the routing-declaring leaf fixture and inspect its structured result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject Skill packages marked as leaf Skills when they declare routing or orchestration behavior.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Revert the validator rule and its test; no persisted state or schema migration is required.

slice_hint.state_transition: The invalid leaf classification produces a validation failure result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted A08 pytest case passes after demonstrating rejection of the false leaf classification.
